description.narrative: Lesotho - Water Sector Project - Urban and Peri-Urban Water Activity: The Urban and Peri-Urban Water Network activity involves reticulation extensions and infrastructure rehabilitation of the urban and peri-urban water network, including reticulation extension to the towns of Semonkong and augmented supply to the town of Mazenod. This activity includes the following components: (i) infrastructure rehabilitation, (ii) reticulation extensions, (iii) the Semonkong water supply system, and (iv) Mazenod Reticulation.
Semonkong water supply system
Rising main extensions in Mafeten-Thabaneng
Mokhotlong reticulation extension

Mazenod reticulation, Mazenod Reservoir

Butha-Buthe reticulation extension
